Notes written while the resources were downloaded and tried (13 November 2026). The files themselves are not in the
repository; [Reproduce](reproduce.qmd) lists the ones the pipeline reads.

## Overview table

From [`resources/pseudo/manifest.json`](https://github.com/ibe-datascience/jutro-pilot-slownictwo/blob/main/resources/pseudo/manifest.json).

```{python}
m = pd.DataFrame(json.loads((D / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
L.dt(m[["resource", "path", "kind", "status", "licence", "size_bytes", "version_or_commit", "url", "sha256", "how_to_run", "notes"]],
     page=25, wrap=["resource", "licence", "version_or_commit", "how_to_run", "notes"], hide=["sha256", "how_to_run", "notes", "version_or_commit"])
```
